source.temporal: constant incremental production from t=0 through 1800 seconds; zero afterward

transport.D_cap_status: conditional generous assumption, not measured BEAM insulin diffusivity or universal maximum

primary_observable: eta30 = external delivered increment by 1800s / increment produced by 1800s

hypothesis.status_rule: supported if numerical interval wholly below .80; refuted if wholly at or above .80; unresolved if overlapping .80

numerics.primary: conservative axisymmetric finite volume with exact-time matrix exponential via spectral decomposition
numerics.independent: separable annular Bessel eigenfunctions and absorbing axial sine series
numerics.quadrature: Gauss-Legendre compared with analytic radial integrals and norms
numerics.uncertainty: truncation bound plus observed FV refinement error; not a formally certified enclosure

outputs.continuous_source_curve: eta for uniform production maintained until each deadline, separate from fixed-pulse cumulative recovery

sensitivities.Robin_status: hypothetical sensitivity parameters; not measured membrane properties
sensitivities.placement_density_rule: preserve same dose by increasing local density; report multiplier and ideal IEQ volume fraction; do not assert realizability

preserve: effective density reconciled to seven nominal annuli
redesign.segmentation: minimum number of <=70mm pouches; full segments plus shorter final segment; no arbitrary subdivisions
redesign.footprint: parallel-pouch bounding rectangle with width n*2R+(n-1)*separation and length longest segment; excludes generator/connectors
redesign.target_selection: minimum side-area grid design meeting target, equivalently largest feasible h if monotonic; explicitly grid-limited

capacity.formula: mean intrinsic secretion per IEQ >= B/(N*T*eta(T))
capacity.B: symbolic incremental insulin demand, not patient recommendation
